[EN] Mission Orders

Overcrowded creatures threaten the camp in Arcanum Outpost. Thin their numbers to keep the people safe.

Kill {@LinkCreature:54#250#baelith arachnen}, {@LinkCreature:54#240#spineback noruks}, and {@LinkCreature:54#160#rippertusk sabertooths}.

Report to Gillian at Scythera Fae when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Criaturas superpobladas amenazan el campamento en Arcanum Outpost. Reduce su número para mantener a la gente a salvo.

Derrota a {@LinkCreature:54#250#baelith arachnen}, {@LinkCreature:54#240#spineback noruks} y {@LinkCreature:54#160#rippertusk sabertooths}.

Preséntate ante Gillian en Scythera Fae cuando la misión haya terminado.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
